we have developed a system to predict and prevent migraines, which can be applied to other chronic diseases and that the system has a significant impact on the reduction of the costs of the healthcare system.

(a) we have shown that the proposed approach can be used in the prediction of the migraine attacks, (b) we have shown a significant reduction in the energy consumption of the system and (c) we have shown how the proposed approach can help to reduce the energy consumption of data centres.

the following: 1) The design and implementation of a low-cost and unobtrusive WBSN to monitor migraine patients; 2) The design and evaluation of low-power techniques applied to the WBSN nodes; 3) The design and analysis of the energy consumption in the Data Center facilities; 4) The analysis of the energy savings and economic impact of our proposal.
